device.description: 16-bit 100 kHz micropower bipolar-input sampling ADC with 3-wire serial interface
device.note: ads8321.pdf (SBAS123B) p.2 pin configuration and assignments, p.3 specifications (VCC range 2.7-5.25 V, binary two's complement), p.9 digital interface, serial interface, Table I timing, Figure 6 basic timing, p.10 data format (Table II)

pages: p.2 (pins), p.3 (specifications: VCC range 2.7-5.25 V, two's complement), p.9 (signal levels: inputs to 5.5 V regardless of VCC; serial interface; Table I: tdDO 50 ns max, tdis 100 ns max; Figure 6), p.10 (Table II codes)
notModeled: analog input (bipolar differential +In - -In, 0 V reads 0000h); the conversion is clocked by DCLOCK (16 clocks, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

DOUT is Hi-Z for the 4.5-5.0 clock sample period: the null bit follows the 5th falling DCLOCK edge (Figure 6; the pin table's 'second clock pulse' wording is from the ADS7816); after B0 the result repeats LSB first (B1..B15, zeros for the 0 V code) and then DOUT tri-states
auto power-down after the conversion and shutdown while CS/SHDN is high (no visible bus effect)
throughput (100 kHz) and DCLOCK frequency limits (0.024-2.9 MHz)
timing values are the VCC = 5 V table (Table I); no low-voltage timing is given
